{{Quote|It's hard to believe this whole complex is built solely to host ''diplomatic negotiations''&hellip; It's ''huge''!''"<br />"''They take diplomacy ''seriously'' here on Gus Talon, Anakin.|Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Power Down" />}}
The '''diplomatic complex''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] was a huge complex built solely to host diplomatic negotiations. The whole facility was automated and self-sufficient, as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] ensured the building ran efficiently. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the diplomatic complex hosted a [[Conference on Gus Talon|conference]] attended by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
